corrections_nonblank: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(DOBROPIS_PRO)<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CREDIT_REF, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(VRUBOPIS_PRO)<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEBIT_REF, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(STORNO_PRO)<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CANCEL_REF, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(CIS_PREDF)<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ADVANCE_REF FROM FAKVY
pos_storno: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(STORNOID)<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NONBLANK_STORNO_REF FROM MOARCHIV
quotes_year: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATUM) AS YR, NABIDKA, COUNT(*) AS N FROM OBJPR GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
validity_year: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATUM) AS YR, JEPLATNY, COUNT(*) AS N FROM SKPOH GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
pende_source_prefix: SELECT SUBSTRING(ZDROJ FROM 1 FOR 2) AS SOURCE_PREFIX, COUNT(*) AS N FROM PENDE GROUP BY 1
attachments_links: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(ID_FV) AS SALES_INVOICE, COUNT(ID_FP) AS PURCHASE_INVOICE, COUNT(ID_OV) AS PURCHASE_ORDER, COUNT(ID_OP) AS SALES_ORDER, COUNT(ID_SK) AS SKU, COUNT(ID_AD) AS PARTNER, COUNT(ID_SP) AS STOCK_MOVE FROM DOCSTORED
stock_refs: SELECT REFERENCE, COUNT(*) AS N FROM SKPOHREF GROUP BY REFERENCE
cashbook_links: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL, COUNT(IDUHR_FV) AS FV, COUNT(IDUHR_FP) AS FP, SUM(CASE WHEN IDUHR_FV IS NULL AND IDUHR_FP IS NULL AND IDUHR_PH IS NULL AND IDUHR_ZV IS NULL AND IDPOKDOK IS NULL AND IDINTDOK IS NULL AND IDBANOBRAT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NO_DOCUMENT_LINK FROM PENDE
accounting_dates: SELECT AGENDA, TYP, COUNT(*) AS N, MAX(LOG_DATE) AS LAST_DATE FROM FIRLOG GROUP BY AGENDA,TYP
config_names: SELECT ITEMNAME FROM FIRMNAST ORDER BY ITEMNAME
pos_config_names: SELECT DISTINCT ITEMNAME FROM MONAST ORDER BY ITEMNAME
recent_fields: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, COUNT(DISTINCT LOG_USER) AS ACTORS FROM SKPOH WHERE DATUM>=DATE '2025-01-01'
number_scale: SELECT TRIM(r.RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS TABLE_NAME, TRIM(r.RDB$FIELD_NAME) AS COLUMN_NAME, f.RDB$FIELD_PRECISION AS PRECISION_VALUE, f.RDB$FIELD_SCALE AS SCALE_VALUE FROM RDB$RELATION_FIELDS r JOIN RDB$FIELDS f ON r.RDB$FIELD_SOURCE=f.RDB$FIELD_NAME WHERE (r.RDB$RELATION_NAME='SKKAR' AND r.RDB$FIELD_NAME IN ('IDR','CISLO','MJ')) OR (r.RDB$RELATION_NAME='ADRES' AND r.RDB$FIELD_NAME IN ('IDRADR','ICO'))
fk_integrity_keylines: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SKPOHPOL p LEFT JOIN SKKAR k ON k.CISLO=p.CISLOKAR WHERE p.CISLOKAR IS NOT NULL AND k.IDR IS NULL) AS MISSING_CARD, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAKVYPOL p LEFT JOIN SKPOHPOL s ON s.IDPOHPOL=p.IDSKPOHPOL WHERE p.IDSKPOHPOL IS NOT NULL AND s.IDPOHPOL IS NULL) AS MISSING_STOCK_LINE FROM RDB$DATABASE
invoice_stock_multiple: SELECT COUNT(*) AS INVOICES_WITH_MULTIPLE_MOVES FROM (SELECT IDFAKVY, COUNT(*) AS N FROM SKPOH WHERE IDFAKVY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY IDFAKVY HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
negative_prices: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CENAMJ<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NEGATIVE_COST, SUM(CASE WHEN POCETMJ<>0 AND CENAMJ=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NONZERO_WITH_ZERO_COST FROM SKKARSTA
card_extra_usage: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(USRFLD1)<>'' OR TRIM(USRFLD2)<>'' OR TRIM(USRFLD3)<>'' OR TRIM(USRFLD4)<>'' OR TRIM(USRFLD5)<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CUSTOM_FIELDS, SUM(CASE WHEN KUSY<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KUSY_NONZERO, SUM(CASE WHEN NEHMOTPRD<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NEHMOTPRD_NONZERO FROM SKKAR
functions_metadata: SELECT TRIM(RDB$FUNCTION_NAME) AS FUNCTION_NAME, TRIM(RDB$MODULE_NAME) AS MODULE_NAME, TRIM(RDB$ENTRYPOINT) AS ENTRYPOINT_NAME FROM RDB$FUNCTIONS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0
kusy_codes: SELECT KUSY, COUNT(*) AS N FROM SKKAR GROUP BY KUSY
selected_config: SELECT ITEMNAME, ITEMVALUE FROM FIRMNAST WHERE ITEMNAME IN ('S_SEPARE','S_FIFO','S_DOMINUSU','S_SKLCALCZPNEW')
balance_hypothesis: SELECT COUNT(*) AS BALANCE_ROWS, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(s.POCETMJ-s.POCPOCETMJ-COALESCE(m.DELTA_QTY,0))>0.00001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MISMATCH_ROWS, MAX(ABS(s.POCETMJ-s.POCPOCETMJ-COALESCE(m.DELTA_QTY,0))) AS MAX_DIFFERENCE FROM SKKARSTA s LEFT JOIN (SELECT h.CISLOSKL,p.CISLOKAR,SUM(CASE WHEN h.JEPRIJEM='T' THEN p.POCETMJ ELSE -p.POCETMJ END) AS DELTA_QTY FROM SKPOHPOL p JOIN SKPOH h ON h.IDPOH=p.IDPOH WHERE h.JEPLATNY='T' AND p.JEUCETPOL='T' GROUP BY h.CISLOSKL,p.CISLOKAR) m ON m.CISLOSKL=s.CISLOSKL AND m.CISLOKAR=s.CISLOKAR
